tokens.TITLE: Shane Boyer x Canada Goose Skate Film
tokens.META_DESCRIPTION: Shane Boyer (@shaneboyerr) skates New York for Canada Goose's Defy the Elements. Inside the #partner film and why his POV eye sells the jacket without a pitch.
tokens.KEYWORDS: Shane Boyer, shaneboyerr, Shane Boyer Canada Goose, Defy the Elements, Canada Goose partner, POV filmmaker, skateboarding, TikTok, New York creator, influencer marketing
tokens.HEADLINE_GOLD: skates New York for Canada Goose.
tokens.DEK: For Canada Goose's Defy the Elements, Shane Boyer put the jacket where his work already lives — on a skateboard, in the weather, across the city. The @shaneboyerr x Canada Goose film sells the product by never pitching it.
tokens.HERO_CAPTION: Shane Boyer skating New York for Canada Goose's Defy the Elements. Courtesy @shaneboyerr / watch on TikTok.
tokens.STAT_FOOTNOTE: Follower/like figures verified July 2026 (TikTok @shaneboyerr, Instagram @shaneboyer_). The Canada Goose film is Boyer's own #partner TikTok post.
tokens.LEAD: Canada Goose builds for the weather, so it makes sense they went to Shane Boyer (@shaneboyerr) — a creator who has spent five years filming New York in every kind of light and season. His Defy the Elements film puts the jacket where his work already lives: on a board, in the cold, moving through the city with the brand simply in frame.
tokens.BODY_1: Boyer came up as a skater, and skate footage is still the spine of what he does for 2.5M+ followers. That heritage is exactly why the Canada Goose fit reads true — the jacket isn't styled onto a model, it's worn by someone actually skating a New York winter. The product earns its place by being useful in the shot.
tokens.H2_1: The jacket in frame, never in a pitch
tokens.BODY_2: His Defy the Elements film is tagged #partner, but it doesn't behave like a spot. There's no hero shot of a price tag — just Boyer's usual cinematic New York with Canada Goose along for the ride. The brand borrows his credibility with a skate-and-city audience, and gets a film that looks like content those viewers already choose to watch.
tokens.PULLQUOTE: The jacket doesn't get a pitch. It gets worn — in the weather, on a board, in his New York.
tokens.PULLQUOTE_CITE: — The DGTL Influence view on Shane Boyer x Canada Goose
tokens.H2_2: Why a heritage brand books a skater
tokens.BODY_3: Because reach without relevance is just noise. Boyer delivers a specific, hard-to-buy audience — people who follow POV New York and skate culture — and a look that makes technical outerwear feel lived-in rather than advertised. For a brand built on defying the elements, being shown surviving a real New York winter beats any studio lighting.
tokens.CALLOUT_TITLE: Why the Canada Goose fit works
tokens.CALLOUT_1: Real use: the jacket is worn skating a real New York winter, not styled on a set.
tokens.CALLOUT_2: Skate heritage gives the partnership built-in credibility.
tokens.CALLOUT_3: #partner content that reads as his own cinematic city work.
tokens.CALLOUT_4: A specific, hard-to-buy skate-and-city audience of 2.5M+.
tokens.BODY_4: It's the creator-led play at its most natural: match a product to the person whose life already contains it, and let the footage do the arguing. Canada Goose wanted proof it defies the elements. Boyer filmed it.
tokens.STATCALLOUT_CAP: Five-plus years filming New York. That heritage is why a Canada Goose jacket on Boyer reads as lived-in — a real skater in a real winter, not a studio setup.

tokens.FAQ_Q1: What did Shane Boyer do for Canada Goose?
tokens.FAQ_A1: Shane Boyer (@shaneboyerr) created a Defy the Elements film for Canada Goose as a brand partner, skating through New York with the jacket in frame. The TikTok post is tagged #partner and shot in his signature cinematic POV style.
tokens.FAQ_Q2: Why did Canada Goose work with Shane Boyer?
tokens.FAQ_A2: Because Boyer is a skater who has filmed New York in every season for over five years, giving Canada Goose real, lived-in footage of its outerwear worn in actual winter conditions — plus a hard-to-buy skate-and-city audience of 2.5M+.
tokens.FAQ_Q3: Where can I watch Shane Boyer's Canada Goose video?
tokens.FAQ_A3: On his TikTok, @shaneboyerr, where the Defy the Elements #partner film is posted and linked from this profile. He also posts on Instagram as @shaneboyer_.
tokens.FAQ_A4: Shane Boyer is an American content creator, skater and POV filmmaker known for cinematic New York City videos, with 2.5M+ TikTok followers. His brand partners have included Canada Goose, Polaroid, YSL and Ray-Ban Meta.
